**Answer Overview**

The request is to change the type of the `ObjectMeta.Labels` field (which is currently `map[string]string`) to a new `LabelMap` type that carries validation semantics. `ObjectMeta` lives in the Kubernetes API machinery (`k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/types.go`) and is embedded in **every** Kubernetes API object. Changing its field type would therefore affect **all** code that reads or writes `.Labels` across the entire code‑base (and any downstream projects that vendor this package).

Below is the evidence we were able to locate:

| Repo | File Path | Evidence |
|------|-----------|----------|
| **addon‑resizer (vendor)** | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/types.go` | `graph_search` returned this file as the definition of the core meta types (`ObjectMeta`, `ListMeta`, etc.). The purpose line states it “Defines common metadata structures …”. This is the file that contains the `ObjectMeta` struct with the `Labels` field. |
| **addon‑resizer (vendor)** | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/meta.go` | `graph_search` returned this file as “Defines interfaces and method implementations for accessing and manipulating metadata fields of Kubernetes API objects”. It provides getters/setters for `ObjectMeta`, confirming that the struct is used throughout the code‑base. |
| **Cilium slim API** | `pkg/k8s/slim/k8s/apis/meta/v1/meta.go` | `graph_search` returned this file as “Provides lightweight method implementations for Kubernetes meta/v1 structures (ListMeta, TypeMeta, ObjectMeta)”. This file re‑implements the same `ObjectMeta` (including `Labels`) for the slim client used by Cilium. |
| **Kustomize vendor** | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured/unstructured.go` | `graph_search` returned this file, which works with unstructured objects that embed `ObjectMeta`. Any code that manipulates unstructured resources also accesses `.Labels`. |
| **Kustomize vendor** | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured/unstructured_list.go` | Same as above for list objects. |
| **Kustomize vendor** | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/watch.go` | Provides conversion utilities for watch events that include `ObjectMeta`. |
| **Kustomize vendor** | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1beta1/types.go` | The v1beta1 alias file also defines `ObjectMeta` (as an alias to v1) – any code that imports the v1beta1 package will see the same `Labels` field. |
